milestone: J8 evaluation, MLflow and model choice

commands.runs/dev-*.txt: vigie-eval run --split dev (one MLflow run per configuration, 14 configurations)
commands.run-test.txt: vigie-eval run --split test (chosen configuration, measured once)
commands.register-refused.txt: vigie-eval register <run of run-test.txt> (refused, gate red)
commands.promotion-demo-dev.txt: vigie-eval run --split dev (e5-large, dense weight 2, English guard), then gate and register with docs/proofs/gates/thresholds-dev-copy.yaml on a scratch MLflow store
commands.e5base-parity.txt: vigie-quant export (per-channel int8, VIGIE_DENSE_MODEL=intfloat/multilingual-e5-base), then python docs/proofs/J8/eval/e5base_parity.py
commands.runs/dev-o-e5-base-int8-perchannel-chunk: vigie-index then vigie-eval run --split dev, VIGIE_DENSE_MODEL=intfloat/multilingual-e5-base VIGIE_DENSE_VARIANT=int8 VIGIE_DENSE_MAX_TOKENS=512 VIGIE_CORPUS_DIR=<350-word chunks>
commands.pod-rss.txt: python docs/proofs/J8/eval/pod_rss.py (API process tree, Qdrant in its own container), configurations o and d, then option 1 with VIGIE_ONNX_LOW_MEMORY=true at commit 07b69e1
